title: Light in a triangle
lesson: Watch a pink-white ray reflect in a silver triangular mirror, reveal direction-colored paths, then fast-forward to a dense light exposure in an illustrated laboratory.
thumbnail_alt: An illustrated scientist in a wooden laboratory beside a large silver-framed triangular mirror, multicolored reflected rays, and a glowing yellow corner-angle arc

Same uninterrupted flight halfway across the mirror

Dense near-white exposure and rainbow direction ring
